stem: In what way does Tama's presence at the train station help the nearby town?

options.label: F
options.text: People in the town want to work at the train station.

options.label: G
options.text: People in the town enjoy taking pictures with the visitors.

options.label: H
options.text: People who come to see Tama often spend money in the town.

options.label: J
options.text: People who come to see Tama want to move to the town.
